D5/S3/Analytic/Probability/BirkhoffPoint.signature: theorem birkhoff_pointwise_ergodic {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {T : α → α} (hT : Ergodic T μ) {g : α → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => birkhoffAverage ℝ T g n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ y, g y ∂μ))
